title: Shared dock terminals loop on Teams sign-in after new MFA-for-everything policy
scenario: A new policy requiring MFA for every app stops shared warehouse terminals whose users cannot approve prompts; the sign-in logs show the policy as the blocker, and widening the grant to hybrid-joined devices ends the loop.

events.title: Teams keeps bouncing people back to sign-in since our MFA rollout
events.text:
Hello support,

On Tuesday afternoon our security lead pushed out a fresh Conditional Access rule that demands MFA for every cloud app, for all users, with a fresh prompt at each sign-in and no exceptions. Since yesterday morning the staff on the shared terminals in the dock office are asked for MFA and Teams drops them back on the sign-in page in a loop. Phones aren't allowed on the dock floor, so nobody there can approve a prompt anyway. About 40 of our 130 users have complained so far.

Imre Solheim, Nordhaven Shipping

events.title: Re: Teams keeps bouncing people back to sign-in since our MFA rollout
events.text:
Hi Imre, thanks for the detail. Three things so I can look at the logs: (1) what the screen actually says when the loop kicks in; (2) three people it happened to, plus a UTC time for each; (3) which devices or locations are hit and which are untouched. You mention one new policy - was anything else changed this week on the network, DNS, proxy or firewall side?

Noor

events.title: Re: Teams keeps bouncing people back to sign-in since our MFA rollout
events.text: Text on screen: 'More information required', then the Authenticator prompt, over and over. Failing: o.nilsen@example.com 06:58 UTC, d.petrov@example.com 07:05, k.asante@example.com 07:19 (we're on CET, UTC+1, so a local clock shows an hour more). Shared terminals fail; staff on their own managed laptops get a prompt on their phone and carry on. There were no network changes at all this month.

events.title: Log lookup and audit log
events.text: Interactive sign-in logs for o.nilsen / d.petrov / k.asante at 06:58 / 07:05 / 07:19 UTC: each has a failure row at that minute, error AADSTS50076, Conditional Access status 'failure', policy 'Require MFA - all apps (v2)' applied. Audit log: that policy was created Tue 14:12 UTC. So the attempts do reach Entra and the new policy is what stops them.

events.title: Findings so far
events.text:
Imre - findings so far. The three failing attempts do reach Entra, and each one is stopped by the new 'Require MFA - all apps (v2)' policy (AADSTS50076). The terminals cannot satisfy the MFA requirement because nobody there can approve a prompt. Suggested change for your security lead, under your change control: let the dock terminals satisfy the policy by being compliant or hybrid-joined devices, rather than by MFA. Expect a note from me around 15:00 UTC to hear how it went.

Noor

events.title: Re: Findings so far
events.text: Our security lead edited the policy at 11:40 UTC to accept hybrid-joined devices as an alternative to MFA. The dock terminals are working now: Olav Nilsen and Dmitri Petrov are both in Teams as I write. We still need to do the same for the second warehouse's terminals.

events.title: Next-day check
events.text:
Hi Imre, I repeated the earlier log query for the window 12:00-15:00 UTC yesterday and again for this morning: the terminal accounts show no failing rows any more, zero rows for them. Please confirm tomorrow morning that the shared terminals stay signed in through a full shift. I'll write again on Friday at 10:00 UTC either way.

Noor

events.title: Re: Next-day check
events.text: Confirmed: the shared terminals have kept their Teams session through today's shift. Please close the case.
